texts.preamble: Ajeem Begam vs The Principal Secretary To Government on 10 February, 2026 Author: M.Dhandapani Bench: M.Dhandapani W In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated: 10-02-2026 Coram The Hon'Ble Mr Justice M.Dhandapani Wp No. 35596 of 2025 and Wmp No.4453 of 2026 Ajeem Begam Vs 1. The Principal Secretary to Government Health and Family Welfare Department, Secretariat, St. George Fort, Chennai-600 006. 2. The Commissioner Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drug Administration Department, Anna Salai, Chennai-600 006. 3. The Commissioner Greater Chennai Corporation, Rippon Building, Chennai-03. 4. The Designated Officer Food Safety and Drug Administration, Thiruvallur- 602 001. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 25/02/2026 03:16:31 pm ) Ajeem Begam vs The Principal Secretary To Government on 10 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32404152/ 1 5. The Designated Officer Food Safety and Drug Administration, Saidapet, Chennai-600 015. Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of Constitution issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing the respondents 1 to 5 to issue or disburse the Family pension, Death Cum Retirement Gratuity (D.C.R.G ) an other service benefits to the petitioner (wife) and other legal heirs of Late.Raja Mohamed, who died on 09.01.2025, while he was working as Food Safety Officer in Sholavaram Block, Thiruvallur District, by considering petitioners representations dated 22.04.2025, 18.07.2025, 22.07.2025 wi a stipulated period of time to be fixed by this Court. For Petitioner(s): M/s.A.Rajeshkanna For Respondent(s): Mr.K.Tippu Sulthan Government Advocate for R1, 2, 4 & 5 Mr.A.Arunbabu for R3 Standing Counsel Order
texts.facts: 2.The learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioners husband, Raja Mohamed, was appointed as a Sanitary Inspector in the office of the 3rd respondent in the year 1998. Subsequently, the Government of Tamil Nadu formed a new department, namely, Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drug Administration Department to implement the Food Safety and Standard Act in Tamil Nadu State through G.O (Ms) No.347, Health and Family Welfare (AB2) Department dated 22.12.2011. Thereafter, the 5th respondent, vide proceedings dated 09.05.2014, appointed the petitioners husband as a Food Safety Officer in the said department with effect from 29.09.2011, and his time scale of pay was also fixed. Subsequently, on 02.07.2018, he was transferred from the 5 th respondent office to the 4th respondent department i.e Sholavaram Block, Thiruvallur District, Ajeem Begam vs The Principal Secretary To Government on 10 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32404152/ 2 under the same designation of Food Safety Officer. Subsequent to the establishment of the said department on 24.09.2018 through G.O (Ms) No.438 dated 24.09.2018, adhoc rules were framed by the 1 st respondent herein. Unfortunately, on 09.01.2025, the petitioners husband died due to heart attack, leaving behind the petitioner and his other legal heirs. grievance of the petitioner is that the terminal benefits of her deceased husband have not been settled in favour of the petitioner and the other legal heirs. Therefore, she made repeated representations on 22.04.2025, 18.07.2025 and 22.07.2025, however, no order has been passed till date.
